'''Sean Elder''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Boulder tournament]] on 12 November 2000 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|World Champion ISB deck with rim scouts, walkers and Sandwhirls]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Johnny Chu's Hidden Base X-wing swarm]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1458">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-boulder-co-11-12-00-2-cold-4-speedersd1458/ boulder-co-11-12-00-2-cold-4-speeders], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-boulder-co-11-12-00-2-cold-4-speedersd1458/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
